title: Neon Canine Apocalypse
description: A surreal fantasy scene shows a giant glowing green dog with a large eye on its side standing over a kneeling woman in a blue and yellow bodysuit who holds a glowing blue staff. A massive black wolf-like monster roars from atop a dark gothic cathedral while a red devil figure casts magic and two women in pink outfits aim guns. The apocalyptic sky is filled with colorful clouds, multiple moons, and lightning.
prompt: A surreal apocalyptic scene featuring a giant glowing green dog with a large realistic eye on its torso, standing protectively over a kneeling woman in a futuristic bodysuit holding a glowing blue staff. A massive black demonic wolf monster roars from the roof of a dark gothic cathedral with glowing pink windows. A red devil sorcerer casts spells, while two women in pink tactical outfits aim guns. Dramatic sky with swirling red, orange and blue clouds, multiple colored moons, lightning, cherry blossoms, and a reflective pool on cracked ground.
